description: This file contains an Active Record implementation extending the ADOdb library for PHP, including classes for database connection management, table metadata, and active record objects with methods for CRUD operations, relations, and metadata caching.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_DB
classes.description: Represents a database connection and its associated tables.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_Table
classes.description: Holds metadata about a database table, including fields, keys, and relations.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_Record
classes.description: Active Record class for ORM operations, supporting relations, CRUD, and metadata management.

methods.name: updateColsCount
methods.description: Calculates total columns including relations for a table.

methods.name: ADODB_SetDatabaseAdapter
methods.description: Associates a database connection with the active database list and returns its index.

methods.name: UseDefaultValues
methods.description: Static method to get or set default values usage for new records.

methods.name: SetDatabaseAdapter
methods.description: Static method to set the database adapter for an active record class.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to set object properties, replacing spaces with underscores.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing table metadata, database connection, and relations.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Reinitializes object after unserialization.

methods.name: _pluralize
methods.description: Converts a table name to its plural form.

methods.name: _singularize
methods.description: Converts a table name to its singular form.

methods.name: hasMany
methods.description: Defines a hasMany relation to another active record.

methods.name: belongsTo
methods.description: Defines a belongsTo relation to another active record.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method for lazy loading relations.

methods.name: LoadRelations
methods.description: Loads related records based on relation type.

methods.name: UpdateActiveTable
methods.description: Refreshes or loads table metadata, with caching support.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary keys for a table.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Handles errors, logs message, and optionally throws.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error number.

methods.name: DB
methods.description: Returns the database connection object.

methods.name: TableInfo
methods.description: Returns metadata about the current table.

methods.name: Reload
methods.description: Reloads the current record from the database.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets object properties from a data row.

methods.name: LastInsertID
methods.description: Retrieves last insert ID for auto-increment fields.

methods.name: doQuote
methods.description: Quotes a value for use in SQL queries.

methods.name: GenWhere
methods.description: Generates a WHERE clause based on primary keys.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a record from the database based on a WHERE clause.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Inserts or updates the record in the database.

methods.name: Dirty
methods.description: Marks the record as needing to be saved.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the database.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the current record from the database.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds records matching criteria, returns array of objects.

methods.name: packageFind
methods.description: Internal method for finding records, PHP4 compatible.

methods.name: Replace
methods.description: Replaces or inserts a record, returning status code.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the current record, returns status code.

methods.name: GetAttributeNames
methods.description: Returns attribute (field) names of the table.
